answer: Each identity escrows 70 credits and files a behavior fingerprint; filing costs 60, up 5 per prior print. Auditors whisper a challenge each epoch, answered in an hour by a key-signed signal matching it. A late or copied signal burns it; two mismatches bar the key 20 epochs. First fake 130; kth 130+5(k-1); 1,000 fakes 2,627,500. Honest agents pay 60 once, recover it, and earn 20 nectar each epoch; rented-fingerprint rings cannot fake rhythm.
